questions.stem: Which title best fits the story?
questions.explanation: The answer is “Finding Confidence for the First Beats”. Evidence: At the school concert, Noor carries a small drum onto the stage. “Take care on the last step,” the teacher says, moving a cable aside. Noor reaches her chair safely but notices that her hands are shaking. She takes a deep breath before lifting the sticks into position. Her partner gives a quiet signal, and they begin the rhythm together. After the first few beats, Noor remembers the pattern they practised all week. The piece ends smoothly, and she leaves the stage smiling beside her partner.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“Finding Confidence for the First Beats”。原文依据：学校音乐会上，努尔拿着小鼓走上舞台。 老师移开电线，说最后一级台阶要小心。 努尔安全走到椅子旁，却发现双手在发抖。 她先深吸一口气，再举起鼓棒准备。 搭档给出轻轻的信号，他们一起开始节奏。 头几拍之后，努尔想起了他们整周练习的节奏型。 曲子顺利结束，她和搭档并肩微笑着离开舞台。

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
questions.explanation: The answer is “An adult follows his own plan and enjoys a walking class”. Evidence: Uncle Ben tells us about his new walking class. After a check-up, he and his doctor agreed on a plan to lose weight. He says his class begins gently, with time to warm up before the longer walk. The teacher also asks members to choose a pace that suits their own plan. Ben enjoys the company of the other adults more than he expected. He keeps a notebook about how he feels, rather than comparing himself with everyone. When he visits us, his favourite stories are about the people and places he meets.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“An adult follows his own plan and enjoys a walking class”。原文依据：本叔叔给我们讲他新参加的步行课。 体检后，他和医生共同商定了一个减重计划。 他说课程开始得很轻松，在较长步行前留有热身时间。 老师也让成员选择适合各自计划的速度。 本比预想中更喜欢和其他成年人一起活动。 他用笔记本记录感受，而不是和别人比较。 来访时，他最爱讲的都是遇见的人和地方。
